brief.prompt:
Create exactly ONE finished Japanese basketball editorial thumbnail as a PNG, landscape 16:9, ideally 1600x900 or higher. This is a brand-new illustration for バスケまとめ. Use case: illustration-story.

Visual style: the approved reference thumbnail's near-black #151A18 and electric lime #CCF43B palette, warm off-white lettering, hand-painted sports ink / scratchy dry brush marks, confident thick Japanese typography, very few elements, strong thumbnail readability. It must be unmistakably a drawn editorial illustration, never photographic or photorealistic.

Composition: left 54% reserved for highly legible type; right 46% for one large real player, Josh Hawkinson / ジョシュ・ホーキンソン, in a dynamic three-quarter rebound-catching pose. His torso twists, both arms reach up-right, BOTH hands firmly gripping opposite sides of ONE basketball above shoulder level. Show his face clearly in three-quarter view, looking toward the ball, focused expression. The ball and both hands must be completely inside the canvas. Upper thighs / torso may deliberately crop at bottom, but no awkward wrist, head, or ball cutoff. Keep all type at least 5% inside the canvas. One vigorous diagonal lime brushstroke behind the figure, sparse ink flecks, no audience or extra people.

Person identity: depict the actual Josh Hawkinson based on the official Tokyo Sunrockers 2026-27 profile reference visually inspected for this task, https://www.sunrockers.jp/lp/josh-hawkinson/ . Adult tall broad-shouldered athletic man; light skin; short dark blond/light brown hair with closely faded sides and longer neatly swept-back side-parted top; high forehead; elongated oval/angular face; straight prominent nose; light blue-gray eyes under fairly straight brows; pronounced square chin; thin lips; clean-shaven appearance with only faint stubble, NO full beard, NO mustache. Preserve these distinctive facial features in the ink drawing; do not substitute a generic fictional athlete. Strong natural anatomy. Right forearm black compression sleeve. Plain off-white basketball uniform with black ink shadows; NO jersey number, NO name, NO team/league/brand/sponsor logo or lettering. Orange ball may be the only warm color accent and must be unbranded. Do not paste or reproduce an official photograph; redraw him completely as expressive ink illustration.

Exact Japanese text, no additional text:
Small masthead upper-left: 「バスケまとめ」
Small date directly beneath it: 「2026.10.25」
Very large bold off-white headline: 「試合結果」
Prominent lime qualifier below, in two clean lines: 「公式記録の」 then 「確定待ち」
Smaller but clearly readable source-as-of line beneath the qualifier: 「10/26 17:40時点」
Bottom-left footer, clear off-white readable text, within safe margins: 「イラスト（AI生成）」 and 「イメージ」

Editorial constraints: All article claims come solely from the supplied frozen article: 10/25 game results are awaiting official confirmation as of 2026-10-26 17:40 JST. Never imply results are confirmed or the selected player appeared or performed in that day's games. Josh was selected randomly from 20 named players in the article, so DO NOT put his name, number, individual statistics, team name, score, achievement, rank, victory, or participation claim anywhere in the image. This action pose is a generic conceptual image, NOT a recreation of any actual play. Use the footer wording exactly as above, NOT 成績をもとにしたイメージ. No logos, watermark, fake signatures, extra panels or copied sample text. Inspectable five-finger anatomy and clear facial features. Deliver one unified professional thumbnail.
